rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supplement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A supplement to a publication such as a book, journal, magazine or newspaper, additional to the main publication.
rdf:Description.skos:note: For example, a colour supplement to a sunday newspaper, or a special supplementary issue of a journal or a journal volume containing invited articles on a special topic, or abstracts or papers presented at a scientific conference.
